Script.name: mudletSpecReloadRenamerScript
Script.script: mudletSpecReloadRenamerRuns = (mudletSpecReloadRenamerRuns or 0) + 1 -- Asks for its own module to be reloaded from inside its own install, by the -- name config.lua renamed it to rather than the name of the file it came in. -- Capped so that a build which lets the reload back into the install recurses -- a few times and is counted, rather than running away and taking the test run -- with it. if mudletSpecReloadRenamerRuns < 3 then reloadModule("mudlet-spec-reloadrenamed") end
